Corner.description: A corner of a surface's sheet as its page shows it: the datum its holes are measured from (doc 12 §2.1).

Hinge.description: The side a door is hinged on (doc 12 §2.8).

oneOf.description: On its left edge, seen from outside.
On its right edge, seen from outside.

Nm.description: A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

Pose3.description: A pose (doc 05 §3.2): translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a unit quaternion in 10^-9. JSON Schema cannot express that q is unit (within 2.001 x 10^9 of 10^18 squared) and sign-normalised (w > 0, or the first non-zero component positive); the reader rejects both.

SurfaceKind.description:
The kind of a mounting surface (doc 12 §2.8): the plate and the six faces of the cabinet, each seen from the side
it is worked from. A kind of a newer format is kept verbatim as [`SurfaceKind::Unknown`].

oneOf.description: The mounting plate, seen from the front.
The left side, seen from the left.
The right side, seen from the right.

SurfacePt2.description: A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

description:
A mounting surface of an enclosure (doc 03 §16, rank 52, the layout file of its enclosure's space): the plane
carriers and placements sit on. A 2D layout page is a view of one surface (FR-LAY-010). At the MVP an enclosure
holds at most one `plate` surface.

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

datum.description:
The corner the surface's holes are measured from; absent: the project's (`WorkshopSettings.datum`), bottom
left when that is absent too.

device.description:
The device of a separate surface part (the mounting plate NSYPMM107, a child of the enclosure's device);
deleting that device clears the member (delete policy unlink).

edge_margin.description: The strip along a door's or a wall's edge where nothing is cut; absent: none.

frame.description: The surface frame in the enclosure: `u`, `v` in the plane, `w` outward.

hinge.description: The side a door is hinged on (doc 12 §2.8); absent on every other surface.

pe_bond.description: Whether the surface is bonded to PE (FR-LAY-058).

usable.description: The usable polygon in the surface frame; empty: none recorded.

title: mounting_surface
